ICS 77.100MTD 13Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard covers the requirements of vanadium pentoxide used for the production of ferrovanadium.2. REFERENCESThe following standards contain provisions which through reference in this text constitute provision of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards listed below:IS 1387 : 1993 General requirements for the supply of metallurgical materials (second revision)IS 460 Test sieves - Specifications:(Part 1) : 2020 Wire cloth test sieve (fourth revision)(Part 2) : 2020 Perforated plate test sieve (fourth revision)(Part 3) : 2020 Methods of examination of apertures of test sieves (fourth revision)
